Only download content you have the right to: your own uploads, content under a licence that allows it (e.g. Creative Commons), or where personal copies are permitted by your local law. Respect creators and YouTube\'s terms. This app does not bypass paid or DRM-protected content.

string-array.name: info_how_steps
string-array.item: Checks the link on your phone (no network) and pulls out the 11-character video ID.
Asks YouTube directly for the video\'s details (title, uploader, year) and its list of audio-only streams, the same way the YouTube website does. No account, no login, no server in between.
Picks the best original-language M4A stream (AAC, about 128 kbps). If there is none, it falls back to Opus in WebM.
Downloads that stream straight from YouTube\'s servers in resumable chunks, in a background service so it keeps going when you leave the app.
Writes title, artist, year and the source link into the file as tags. The audio itself is never re-encoded, so it stays exactly as YouTube serves it.
Saves it to Music/AudioSaver through Android\'s MediaStore, so no storage permission is needed, then checks that the saved file is complete.

resources.string: YouTube has no official download API. The app reads YouTube the way a browser does, and YouTube changes its site often and deliberately makes this harder. When something goes wrong, the error card says exactly what happened:

string-array.name: info_errors
string-array.item: Age-restricted, private, members-only, paid or region-locked videos: these need a signed-in account or another country, and the app never logs in. Retrying won\'t help.
Video unavailable or live stream: the video was removed, the link is wrong, or it is still live. Check the link in the YouTube app, or wait until the stream has ended.
\"Confirm you\'re not a bot\" or rate-limited: YouTube is suspicious of your network. Wait a while, switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data, or turn off any VPN, then tap Retry.
Network error or download failed: the connection dropped. Check your internet and tap Retry.
\"YouTube changed something\" or no audio stream found: YouTube changed its site and the extractor has to catch up. Retry later and update the app once a newer NewPipeExtractor is out.
Couldn\'t save the file: usually the phone is out of storage. Free up some space and tap Retry.

resources.string: If an error keeps happening, long-press the message on the error card to copy it into a bug report.

string-array.name: info_libs
string-array.item: NewPipeExtractor (TeamNewPipe): reads video details and stream links from YouTube
OkHttp (Square): HTTP client for the extractor and the download
Kotlin and kotlinx.coroutines: language and background work
Jetpack Compose with Material 3: the user interface
AndroidX Core, Activity and Lifecycle: Android app plumbing
Android desugar_jdk_libs: newer Java APIs on Android 10 to 12
Own code for link checking, chunked downloading and M4A tagging (no FFmpeg)
